caption: Without a rule, the core cards view cuts each quote off after one line.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', null); for (let i=0;i<40 && !document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-cards-item');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The title on 2 lines and the quote on 4 lines, with an ellipsis at the cut. Each property after the title gets the same space, and all cards keep one height.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', {"props": {"file.name": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 2}, "note.quote": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 4}}, "all": {"mode": "core", "lines": 3}}); for (let i=0;i<40 && !document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-cards-item');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The quote wraps to the end of the value in a box of up to 10 lines.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', {"props": {"file.name": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 2}, "note.quote": {"mode": "wrap", "lines": 10}}, "all": {"mode": "core", "lines": 3}}); for (let i=0;i<40 && !document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-cards-item');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The command Set card wrap for this view opens one row for all properties and one row for each property of the view.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', {"props": {"file.name": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 2}, "note.quote": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 4}}, "all": {"mode": "core", "lines": 3}}); app.commands.executeCommandById('bases-card-wrap:set-view-rule'); for (let i=0;i<40 && !document.querySelector('.bcw-modal .bcw-rule-row');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.bcw-modal .bcw-rule-row')) throw new Error('no modal'); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The same rule applies where the base is embedded in a note, in Reading view and Live Preview.
eval: (async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.modal-container').forEach(el => el.remove()); const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', {"props": {"file.name": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 2}, "note.quote": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 4}}, "all": {"mode": "core", "lines": 3}}); const l=app.workspace.getLeaf(false); const s=l.getViewState(); await l.setViewState({...s,state:{...s.state,mode:'preview'}}); for (let i=0;i<60 && !document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-view.bcw-on');i++) await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100)); if (!document.querySelector('.workspace-leaf.mod-active .bases-view.bcw-on')) throw new Error('embed has no rule'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600)); return 'ok'; })()

caption: The settings list each view that has a rule. Select a row to edit it, or delete it.
eval: (async () => { const pl=app.plugins.plugins['bases-card-wrap']; await pl.setViewRule('Bases Card Wrap/Quotes.base\u0000Quotes', {"props": {"file.name": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 2}, "note.quote": {"mode": "clamp", "lines": 4}}, "all": {"mode": "core", "lines": 3}}); app.setting.open(); app.setting.openTabById('bases-card-wrap'); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); return 'ok'; })()
